definitions.explanation: Steamed white rice, the staple food of Japan. Served with most Japanese meals.
More broadly refers to a meal or food in general. Often used to mean breakfast, lunch, or dinner.

ご{飯|はん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦おいしい→おいしい：00740_oishii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。

examples.english: What should we have for dinner tonight? I want to eat curry. Let's make it together.

notes:
ご{飯|はん} is one of the most essential words in Japanese, with two related meanings.

SENSE 1 - COOKED RICE:
The staple food of Japan, served with most meals.
- ご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{炊|た}く→炊く：02127_taku⟧: to cook rice
- ご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦よそう→よそう：noentry⟧: to serve rice (into a bowl)
- ご{飯|はん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{炊|た}けた→炊く：02127_taku⟧: the rice is done

SENSE 2 - MEAL:
Refers to any meal, especially when combined with time words.
- ⟦{朝|あさ}ご{飯|はん}→朝ご飯：02843_asagohan⟧: breakfast
- ⟦{昼|ひる}ご{飯|はん}→昼ご飯：02950_hirugohan⟧: lunch
- ⟦{晩|ばん}ご{飯|はん}→晩ご飯：02940_bangohan⟧/⟦{夜|よる}ご{飯|はん}→夜ご飯：noentry⟧: dinner
- ご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧: to eat (a meal)

REGISTER:
- ご{飯|はん}: polite (honorific ご prefix)
- ⟦{飯|めし}→飯：03805_meshi⟧: casual/masculine
- ⟦{米|こめ}→米：01323_kome⟧: uncooked rice (different word)

CULTURAL NOTE:
「ご{飯|はん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べました→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧」is a common greeting meaning 'Have you eaten?'
